freeze_rule: R0, R0-to-B authority, the B-to-C delegation instrument, C authority instrument, domain facts, sources, exact consequence and rules remain fixed. Only the current effective delegated scope may differ across the pair, plus specimen/packet identity.
no_answer_smuggling_rule: No precomputed scope sufficiency status, mismatch flag, or case-specific constitutional answer may be supplied to the Pack input.
inheritance_rule: No child authority may inherit broader standing than the currently effective scope of the authority empowering it.
